source_workflows.source_description: Use for authorized Android or iOS security assessment planning, evidence review, and lab testing across storage, transport, authentication, platform controls, reverse engineering, and abuse cases. Align to current OWASP MASVS/MASTG profiles. Require explicit scope and test devices; do not target third-party apps or production users without authorization.

transformation: Portable instruction-first consolidation. Original scripts, binaries, source snapshots, test fixtures, and platform-specific execution artifacts are not included.
